name: Sam's Club Distribution Center Searcy AR

fieldNotes.location: Supplied coords (35.243754,-91.736442, APPROXIMATE) landed in downtown Searcy ~3.5km too far west. Resolved the real DC to 3301 E Park Ave at 35.2419,-91.6976 via warehouserating/opengovny listings, confirmed on satellite as a large white-roof DC with fenced drop yards, dock apron, retention ponds and a rail spur.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Perimeter is fully chain-link fenced (confirmed in Street View). Single controlled access is a gravel/paved crossing over the rail spur from the north access road into the drop/truck yard (~35.2426,-91.7020). No barrier arm visible from overhead; classed as a gate on the strength of the full fence + single pinch-point crossing + web listing stating 'gate, entrance security, strict appointment requirements'. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed multi-window booth visible at the entrance crossing in z20-z21 satellite or Street View. A small structure near the crossing reads as a rail/utility cabinet, not a guard shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no visible guard shack -> inferred kiosk/appointment/app check-in (Sam's Club / Walmart DCs run appointment-based driver check-in). Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur (double track) runs along the north property edge directly beside the building, inside the fence; a J.B. Hunt Intermodal container was parked in the yard (confirmed in Street View), corroborating intermodal/rail-served operations.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South building wall is one long continuous dock face with a regular rhythm of doors and trailers backed in across its full ~600m length; estimated 50+ (count ~120, low precision from overhead).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large drop areas: a gravel NW drop yard with long rows of parked trailers and an angled-stall paved drop yard south of the dock apron, both heavily occupied; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC building plus a small in-yard dispatch/yard office near the south dock apron; a separate trailer-maintenance/warehouse cluster sits just west but appears to be an adjacent property, not counted.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unpaved/gravel apron at the north crossing and large open yard width give ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Broad paved maneuvering area between the dock apron and the south drop stalls serves as inside-gate staging/queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Searcy AR beside US-67/167 with open fields and residential to the north; judged Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Town-edge location with nearby development and a highway; cellular likely adequate, so false, but flagged as inferred.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single crossing point; lane count not separately markable from overhead, estimated 1 in / 1 out at one combined gate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter polygon (~664m x ~395m envelope, minus ponds/irregular SW); ~58 acres, approximate.
